title: podía, había + -ido (had done), ya, quería, buscar

cards.title: Two 'could's: podría vs podía
cards.body: Future/conditional 'could' = podría. Past 'could' (was able to) is usually the line past: podía.

examples.en: I couldn't do it because I didn't have the time.
examples.es: No podía hacerlo porque no tenía el tiempo.

cards.title: Line or dot? Decide by context
cards.body: Whether to use the line or the dot past depends on the context, not on which form English uses. Sometimes both work.

cards.title: había + -ido = had done (always the line past)
quería: wanting is ongoing
cards.body: Querer works in the line past even where English uses a simple past. Add él / yo to make clear who did what.

examples.en: He wanted to have dinner with me, but I'd already eaten.
examples.es: Él quería cenar conmigo, pero yo ya había cenado.

cards.title: buscar = to look for
cards.body: No 'for' needed. 'Had' vs 'have' works just like English.

examples.en: He was looking for it because I had lost it.
examples.es: (Él) lo buscaba porque yo lo había perdido.

cards.title: habría: the e naturally drops out
